what: A pink ring fills over 4s with no easing (every 50ms by the remaining share, .05s linear) while the number in the white center circle counts 4 → 3 → 2 → 1. When full, it emits fx:done after 100ms and stops to wait. The caller advances the slider to the next slide and sends fx:reset, which empties the ring instantly (no easing) and starts counting again from the beginning. Used for the ‹Next slide in› indicator beside the Hero slider

options.--fx-width: Ring thickness (css), default 6 — for phone 4 (with diameter 36, if radius is 16, data-fx-part=Change the r of ring)
options.--fx-track: Panel color under the ring (css), default --kf-accent-soft
options.[data-fx-part=ring]: Ring circle (optional — if absent, the part puts one in the 56 board with radius 25)
options.fx:reset / fx:done: Sending restarts the count · Receive it once the count is complete

note: Counts even under reduced motion — it is the slider’s page-turn tempo (only the ring transition is turned off)

from.where: index.html .yk-count next to the latest topic (original top.js — i via setInterval at 50ms = ceil(4 − s), stroke-dashoffset = Perimeter × (1 − s/4) · transition .05s linear, when full, slickNext after 100ms, restart in afterChange)
